responsibility: Implements the custom diagnostic finalizer used by the Rust resolver’s intentional internal-compiler-error easter egg path. This file defines funny_ice_text_finalizer, a no-return wrapper around GCC’s default diagnostic text finalization for DK_ICE_NOBT diagnostics that replaces the normal bug-reporting tail with a Rust-specific message and then exits with ICE_EXIT_CODE when the resolver chooses to trigger that special diagnostic.
same_name_distinction: Defines the funny_ice_text_finalizer function declared in the header, calling GCC's default text finalizer, appending the custom Rust message, and terminating with ICE_EXIT_CODE for the special resolver ICE path.
